newsitem.title: UK: Edge buys retails park, plans rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Edge buys retails park, plans rights issue.

text.p: Edge Properties Plc said on Friday that it has agreed to buy the Meols Cop Retail Park for 21 million stg.
The company also said it is planning to raise around 26 million stg via a three-for-five rights issue of 19.95 million shares at 135p per share. Cazenove has underwritten the issue.
Edge will use the proceeds of the issue to finance its acqusition of the Meols Cop retail park, located at Southport in Northern England.
It also announced that it is buying a retail property for 13 million stg at Milton Keynes in southern England.
The company said it remains confident about its prospects for the year.
